name: In a room
author: ultralazr
description: After Alvin Lucier's "I am sitting in a room" (1969). You record a phrase, and on every pass the loop plays through a model of a room and is recorded again. The room's resonances pile up, and after enough passes speech melts into a chord. The counter shows the generation. Choose one of four rooms with Shape. Push blue to set Loop to a free length or one of six tempo-synced lengths.
credits: Musica Obscura by ultralazr, after Alvin Lucier; from op1r, ported to kennel by Hundekraft
